title: This Shark Launches Itself 20 Feet Out of the Water

scenes.text: This shark jumps 20 feet out of the water.
It's a shortfin mako, nicknamed Blue Dynamite for its leaps.
When hooked, it often jumps two or three times to break free.
Bursts of speed can reach about 42 miles an hour.
Just reaching 20 feet takes roughly 25 miles an hour.
No wonder it's called one of the fastest sharks in the sea.

description:
The shortfin mako can launch itself up to 20 feet out of the water.
Fisheries scientists say short bursts reach about 42 miles an hour, and hooked makos often leap two or three times.
Would you get in the water with one?
first_comment: Fastest shark or fastest fish: what do you think is quicker?
